newsitem.title: USA: LaSalle/Kross has 5.2 pct of Standard Financial.
newsitem.headline: LaSalle/Kross has 5.2 pct of Standard Financial.

text.p: LaSalle/Kross Partners LP said Tuesday it has purchased 850,000 shares, or 5.2 percent of the common outstanding stock, of Standard Financial Inc.
LaSalle/Kross, a private investment fund, said it disclosed the holding in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Standard Financial is the holding company for Standard Federal Bank for Savings of Chicago.
LaSalle/Kross said it emphasizes investments in the common stock of undervalued, strong franchise and "special situation" financial institutions.

The partnership said it will continue to evaluate Standard Financial and its business prospects, and also intends to consult with management and other shareholders regarding corporate governance matters relating to the 1997 annual meeting.
LaSalle/Kross was not immediately available for further comment.
